Name: Ordinary Shane and Yandere Shane Portraits for Portraiture
Author: Gabihime
Description:
Does Shane just not hit you the way you really think he should? (METAPHORICALLY PEOPLE, METAPHORICALLY).  No worries.  I gotchu fam.

In fact, I've even got a Shaft head tilt for you.

This portrait set endeavors to depict him close to his implied age, with the physical effects of his terrible lifestyle apparent.  Alcoholism isn't nice, children, nor is it sexy.  In case you still want to try and rescue this trainwreck, now you have two entirely different portrait sets to choose from!
 
This is the part where I would suggest you use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14211]Yandere Shane[/url] mod for the yandere portraits, but given Shane's personality, I think you could use the yandere portraits with just about any mod, as well as with Vanilla.  Modders take note, there is only one set of duplicates among all the portraits, so you're welcome to make use of every single one of them.  The yandere portraits even feature yandere Charlie the Chicken.  You can't beat that.

Shane's clothing has been reworked in these portraits to my own taste, with a back story of a talented and passionate back country guide who suffered a devastating blow when a severe chronic illness took away his life and his livelihood.  He turned to alcohol as a result of his illness and his new reality of working a dead-end job at Jojamart.  With this in mind, he's now wearing the sort of technical gear an outdoor guide or avid hiker would wear, complete with a wetsuit and sports sunglasses for the beach.

I intend to write a dialogue and event mod to support this framing of Shane once I have a little more free time.  Until then, there are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1061]many [/url]excellent [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1167]Shane [/url]mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3489]available[/url], and his clothing is close enough to his original clothing that it should fit seamlessly regardless of the mod you're using.

These are portraits for portraiture.  Just unzip the portraits and throw them in the portraits folder of your portraiture mod folder.

Like my Harvey portraits, these are meant to be friends with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15234]LT4823[/url]'s portrait sets, since they're the ones I use.
